title: Legal Notice No. 1 of 2026 — THE LEGAL PROFESSION (ELIGIBILITY FOR ADMISSION) ORDER, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part B—Vol. 65, No. 2—5th January, 2026 1
LEGAL NOTICE NO. 1
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
THE LEGAL PROFESSION ACT, CHAP. 90:03
ORDER
MADE BY THE MINISTER AFTER CONSULTATION WITH THE CHIEF JUSTICE
UNDER SECTION 15A OF THE LEGAL PROFESSION ACT
THE LEGAL PROFESSION (ELIGIBILITY FOR ADMISSION)
ORDER, 2026
1. This Order may be cited as the Legal Profession (Eligibility for Citation
Admission) Order, 2026.
2. The person referred to in Part I of the Schedule, being a Eligibility for
Commonwealth citizen admitted to practise law in England and Wales admission to
practise
for not less than ten years, is eligible to be admitted to practise law in
Trinidad and Tobago subject to the terms and conditions specified in
Part II of the Schedule.
SCHEDULE
PART I
Name Professional Qualification
Mr. Richard John Thomas K.C. Of the Honourable Society of Inner
Temple: Barrister, admitted to
practise at the Bar of England and
Wales in October, 2002.
PART II
Mr. Richard John Thomas K.C. is eligible to be admitted to practise law as an
Attorney-at-law in relation to the following cause and any matters, suits or other
proceedings arising out of or in connection with the cause, namely:
An application by Mr. Garvin Guerra for a review by the Review Tribunal
of his Detention pursuant to paragraph 5(1) of the Schedule to the Emergency
Powers Regulations, 2025.
Dated this 2nd day of January, 2026.
J. JEREMIE
Attorney General
PRINTED AND PUBLISHED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, PORT-OF-SPAIN
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO—2026
